name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Brennen: live panes, commands and tools that run inside Claude Code

plugins.name: room
plugins.description: Codex, Cursor and a second Claude inside Claude Code: an agent room (one chat, @mentions, handoffs) plus one-shot reviews and delegation

plugins.name: mod-firewall
plugins.description: A firewall for Claude Code mods: watches what every other mod does (network, processes, secret files, env vars) and asks, blocks or logs

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: See and message your other Claude Code and Codex sessions: who is working on what, direct messages, broadcast, handoffs, an inbox that holds incoming messages for approval, and live warnings when another session edited the same file

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm for as long as you choose, then compacts or hands off before it expires; holds a costly cold send with its price and your choices; /keepwarm opens a pane with the session's settings

plugins.name: ctx-control
plugins.description: See and control the skills, tools, files, and other context sent with every message

plugins.name: effort-router
plugins.description: Sets the effort of each main-conversation turn from how demanding its prompt is, rated by Jev (through OpenRouter or TypeSafe) with Haiku as the fallback; /effort-router opens a pane with the mapping, thresholds and a prompt tester
